title: PDF Editor Traces: one edited figure, 18 PDF editors
description:
Seven synthetic documents (ReportLab, headless Chrome, Apple Numbers, TCPDF, mPDF, WeasyPrint, fpdf2), each edited by hand in 17 online PDF editors and desktop Word: 109 edited files, with a per-file record of what the editor changed besides the figure (revisions, metadata, content-stream marks, fonts, and whether the old figure is still in the file).

Every document is synthetic and marked SAMPLE. Write-up: https://atomara.io/blog/pdf-editor-traces.
